test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A tank has two inlets A and B that can fill it in 5 h and 6 h respectively. An outlet C can empty the full tank in 30 h. If all the three pipes are opened together in the empty tank, how much time will the pipes take to fill the tank?
solution:
Given:

A tank has two inlets A and B that can fill it in 5 h and 6 h respectively. 

An outlet C can empty the full tank in 30 h.

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency (Work done per hour) × Total time taken 

Calculation:

LCM (5, 6, 30) = 30

Let the capacity of the tank be the LCM of the time taken by all pipes.

Hence, the capacity of the tank = 30 units

Thus,

Inlet A fills the tank each hour by = 30 ÷ 5 = 6 units

Inlet B fills the tank each hour by = 30 ÷ 6 = 5 units

Outlet C empties the tank each hour by = 30 ÷ 30 = 1 unit

Hence, time taken to fill the tank when all pipes are opened = {30 over (6 + 5 - 1)} = 3 hours

**∴ All the three pipes are opened together in the empty tank, 3 hours will the pipes take to fill the tank.**
